label: View files
description: Browse recordings in the group’s repository.

label: Transcribe
description: Trigger transcription jobs on ingested audio.

label: Edit transcripts
description: Modify transcript text, timestamps, and speaker labels.

label: Submit for review
description: Send transcripts to the review queue.

label: Review
description: Approve, reject, or request changes on submitted transcripts.

label: Pseudonymise
description: Apply masking to PII spans on approved transcripts.

label: Export
description: Download transcripts and recordings in supported formats.

label: Create datasets
description: Curate file subsets into named engineer datasets.

label: Train models
description: Launch training / fine-tuning jobs against the group’s datasets.

label: Submit to leaderboard
description: Enter models into the group’s leaderboard.

label: Manage group members
description: Add or remove users from this group. Admin-level; off by default.
